title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Coliseum on 1982-09-23
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy fall‑82 show with a smoking Wheel/Other One/Wharf Rat sequence and electric Althea, captured on an excellent Charlie Miller soundboard.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered for its relentless drive – the long Wheel jam, the fiery Other One into Wharf Rat, and a blistering Althea that showcases Jerry’s soaring guitar. Reviewers praise the crisp soundboard mix (Charlie Miller) that finally brings Phil’s bass forward and highlights Brent’s B‑3 work, making the performance both sonically and musically compelling.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and emphasize strong playing and a great soundboard; only one mixed/negative comment drags the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix with Brent’s B3 prominent and Phil’s bass unusually audible for this era; no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly; transitions like Wheel → Other One → Wharf Rat are highlighted as especially tight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing is described as "on" and "electric," with a standout solo on Althea and strong tone on Little Red Rooster.
band_member_comments.Phil: Usually low in the mix for this period, but reviewers note he’s more audible here, adding power to the performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Slide work on Althea is mentioned positively despite earlier criticism of his slide technique.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's B3 organ presence is praised as a key factor in the show's energy.
